name: release-rebalance-saveslots-0.2.3
desc: Rebalance SaveSlots 0.2.3: pages of 5 rows (21 pages) replace the 5-row hint; pager Q < 1 … 21 > E under the list, clickable; Q/E go to the previous/next page.
commits: feat(rebalance-saveslots): page bar Q < 1 … 21 > E replaces the 5-row hint (0.2.3)

Rows are grouped in pages of 5 (101 rows = 21 pages). Q/E select the first row of the previous/next page; a clickable pager under the list shows every page number with the current one highlighted, using Common/ui_common_arrow_02 and the game's Q/E key icons. The pager is built once per storage panel. OnStorageItemIndexChanged postfix keeps the highlight in step with clicks.
chore: release script for Rebalance SaveSlots 0.2.3
